QUOTE: The right side is matched against the tool name plus the first string value in the args JSON (`ServerManager::args_to_pattern`, `server_manager.cpp:426`). Empty args, `{}`, or a non-string first value all become `*`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: States that only the first string arg value reaches the pattern and that empty or non-string first values collapse to `*`. The rest of the args being invisible follows from this. The answer doesn't mention unparseable args.
